Welcome. The pages on this site are **live**: every code cell runs Python in
your browser — nothing to install, nothing to set up. Edit the code, press
**Run Code**, and the chart updates.

## How to use these pages

1. Read the section, then run the reconstruction cell as given.
2. Run the verification cell and check every assertion passes.
3. Attempt the **intervention exercise**. Use the hints if you're stuck;
   compare with the solution only after you've made your own attempt.

Your work here is **not saved** when you close the tab. These pages are for
practice in class and revision afterwards. Assessed work (A1, A2) is still
submitted as notebooks through Canvas as described in each brief.
